description: Predict dense and sparse routed language-model learning curves across model size, routing configuration, checkpoint step, and cumulative compute.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are loss c4, loss curation corpus, loss lambada, loss pile, loss validation, loss wikitext103.
